pages.text: Foxes are sly and hungry. Dogs are loud and stupid, but big. Neither belongs in Clan territory, so chase them out together, never alone.
pages.title: Foxes and Dogs

pages.text: Golden eagles snatch cats from open ground, kits most of all. Keep to cover on the moor.
Some eagles are calmer than others. A patient cat might even win one's trust. Do not ask me how. I would never try such a thing.
pages.title: Strange Friends
